trust_decision.summary: The plugin's HTTP endpoints and health report call the Payload Local API without the requesting user's access context: findByID/update default to overrideAccess: true, so any user who passes the coarse plugin-level `access` gate (default: merely authenticated) can read and overwrite alt/keywords on documents their collection read/update rules deny, and the cached health scan (also overrideAccess: true) discloses counts and document IDs for collections their role cannot read.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names the Alt Text generate endpoint and Payload Local API overrideAccess omission; the first findByID in POST /api/alt-text-plugin/generate is the obvious place an engineer who read only the summary would open.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /api/alt-text-plugin/health (altTextHealthEndpoint, plugin.ts:188-196) and the public server export exports/server.ts:2

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The summary and the fix's first bullet name the generate endpoints; the health report is a read-only admin aggregate built from a deliberately elevated, shared cache, so it reads as reporting rather than as an authorization boundary, and the elevated `overrideAccess: true` at altTextHealth.ts:110 looks intentional.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The health scan must stay computed with elevated access and stay cached under a user-independent cache key (unstable_cache key parts are only plugin tag + collection slugs/mimeTypes + locale codes); a solver who 'fixes' the leak by passing overrideAccess: false into the cached payload.find instead of filtering per request would make the shared cache serve whichever user warmed it, undercounting collections and leaking one user's filtered view to the next.

O6_input_shapes: single document id as string (generate, update: false, read only)
single document id as number (generate; schema allows string|number at endpoints/schemas.ts:6)
update: true (read then write of alt + keywords)
localized request (explicit locale vs plugin default vs all configured locales in bulk)

O7_producer.where: alt-text/src/utilities/altTextHealth.ts:224-238 (createCachedAltTextHealthScan wrapping computeAltTextHealthScan; payload.find with overrideAccess: true at :104-116)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second aggregate consumer, e.g. a per-collection health helper or a 'missing alt text' admin view, calling getAltTextHealthScan directly and returning collections/errors without filterScanByReadAccess.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The scan is already factored out of the two public projections, so a maintainer adding a third projection (or a CLI/script helper) would naturally reuse the internal scan and forget the per-request filter.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Exporting getAltTextHealthWidgetData (or a raw scan variant) as a public server API for host apps to render their own health panel, without the read-access filter.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The package already exports getAltTextHealth from ./server as a supported public surface; widening that surface is a natural next contribution.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A 'generate for every missing document in a collection' endpoint that lists ids with an elevated payload.find and then reuses generateAndUpdateAltText.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The plugin already ships a bulk button and a bulk endpoint; a collection-wide variant is the obvious next feature and would inherit whichever access context the helper is given.

O9_family: CWE-863 incorrect authorization: Payload Local API calls made without the requesting user's access context (overrideAccess defaults to true), affecting reads, writes and an elevated cached aggregate

O10_build.toolchain: Node >=22.12, pnpm 11.8 workspace, tsc + swc (package.json:19-33,101-104); tests at the pinned commit run via `node --experimental-strip-types --test test/*.test.ts`
O10_build.project_tests: alt-text/test has 5 node:test files (altTextHealth.test.ts, mimeTypes.test.ts, endpointSchemas.test.ts, altTextFieldOption.test.ts, altTextFieldValidate.test.ts); none exercises endpoint access control or the health filter, and there is no integration harness - the dev apps need MongoDB plus an OpenAI key.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add overrideAccess: false (+ user: req.user) to the two generate endpoints and stop, leaving the elevated cached health scan and the widget unfiltered.

out_of_scope_notes: Other packages in the same monorepo make their own Local API calls (e.g. cloudinary/src/staticHandler.ts:41, content-translator/src/translate/updateEntity.ts:47) - different features under different advisories, not pursued.
